relative_projective_certificate.comparison: lower_multiplier * M_approx <= M_true <= upper_multiplier * M_approx componentwise
relative_projective_certificate.measure_scale: unnormalized first-mark entrance density; M_approx mass is source_unnormalized_mass_exact
relative_projective_certificate.later_operation_scope: same positive linear operator on true and acquired entrance; finite nonzero output mass; subsequent numerical approximation needs its own certificate
relative_projective_certificate.source_scope: strictly positive stationary local distributions; finite independent binary leaves; one irreversible autonomous opening; specified local firing reset
relative_projective_certificate.retained_state_scope: post-event leaf configuration with known open controller at the exactly observed event time; mixture labels are representation indices, not a TV approximation of the continuous opening time
